messages.content: ekjon creator hisebe negative feedback ke productively kivabe use kora jai, bistarito bolo.

Honestly প্রথমেই feedback টাকে emotion theke আলাদা kore dekhার try koro actually - defensiveness first reaction hote pare, kintu sheta genuinely useful information miss kore dite pare. Second step hocche pattern lokkho kora, ekta comment na, jodi shomanya feedback multiple manush dey tahole sheta signal, ekjon dile hoyto sheta just personal preference. Third, honestly actionable feedback ke non-actionable theke separate koro - 'ami pochondo kori na' type comment theke 'X better hote parto Y kore' type comment onek beshi useful. Finally, sotti bolte, feedback ke publicly respond korার age nijer sathe process kora dorkar - immediate defensive reply prায়ই situation worse kore, thoughtful response better perception create kore actually.
